description: This file defines the Vtiger_PDF_ContentViewer class responsible for rendering PDF content in the Vtiger CRM system. It manages content models, watermarks, and handles the display logic for rendering content in PDF format.
external_methods: FPDF methods: MultiCell(), GetStringWidth(), GetStringHeight(), SetFont(), SetTextColor(), Text(), GetY()

classes.name: Vtiger_PDF_ContentViewer
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering PDF content with support for content models, watermarks, and page management in Vtiger CRM.

methods.name: addContentModel
methods.description: Adds a content model to the list of models to be rendered.

methods.name: setContentModels
methods.description: Sets multiple content models at once, replacing existing ones.

methods.name: setSummaryModel
methods.description: Sets the summary model for the content.

methods.name: setWatermarkModel
methods.description: Sets the watermark model for the content.

methods.name: totalHeight
methods.description: Returns the total height of the content; currently returns 0 indicating variable height.

methods.name: initDisplay
methods.description: Initializes the display area for the PDF, drawing a border using MultiCell.

methods.name: displayWatermark
methods.description: Displays a watermark on the PDF if a watermark model is set.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the content models into the PDF, handling multi-page content and footer addition.
